description: This stacked bar chart illustrates the proportional distribution of different target categories across a series of years. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Year," with values ranging from 2012 to 2022 ordered chronologically and rotated vertically. The vertical axis represents the value on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 0.2 and corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines. Each bar is stacked to a uniform total height of 1.0, with individual colored segments representing specific target counts as defined by a legend titled "Targets." The legend maps blue to "0," orange to "1," green to "2-4," red to "5-7," and purple to "8+," and the segments are stacked from bottom to top in this respective order. The composition of the bars varies significantly across the years; for example, the 2012 bar is composed entirely of the green "2-4" category (1.0), and the 2013 bar consists entirely of the blue "0" category (1.0). Other years show mixed distributions, such as 2019, which contains blue (~0.2), orange (~0.2), green (~0.22), red (~0.34), and a small purple segment (~0.04). The purple "8+" category represents the shortest segments overall and appears only at the top of the bars for the years 2019, 2020, and 2021. The bars are sorted chronologically from left to right. Visually, the bar for the year 2022 is distinguished from the others by being rendered in lighter, translucent shades of the standard category colors, and a blurred gray rectangular area obscures the top edge of the chart area above the bars.
